description: This file defines a Python class 'ExceptionDump' and its subclass 'ReverseExceptionDump' for internal exception traceback handling, formatting, and dumping, including environment info and object state serialization.

classes.name: ExceptionDump
classes.description: Represents a traceback with methods for formatting, dumping, and generating a hash for duplicate detection.

classes.name: ReverseExceptionDump
classes.description: Subclass of ExceptionDump that reverses the traceback order for display.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes ExceptionDump with exception info and config.

methods.name: desc
methods.description: Provides a one-line description of the exception.

methods.name: _get_environment_info
methods.description: Collects environment and package info for bug reports.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the exception report.

methods.name: _format_stack
methods.description: Formats the traceback stack into a list of strings.

methods.name: _dumpClass
methods.description: Recursively dumps an object's attributes for debugging.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Dumps local variables, object attributes, callbacks, and files.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Generates a SHA-256 hash of the traceback for duplicate detection.

methods.name: traceback_and_object_dump
methods.description: Returns combined traceback and object state as a string.
